drivers.p: Brent is down 7.8% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 94.08 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
